# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 to 21 years old over the course of volumes 2 and 3  <sub>[v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 c19 P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c6 P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v3 c4 P10](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged  <sub>[v3 c27 P18](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0018), [v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c4 P33](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0033)</sub>
- **Role:** Redmond College student  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is a very pretty girl with vivid, irregular features, smooth nut-brown hair, big velvety brown eyes under oddly-pointed black brows, and a rose-red, crooked mouth. She has a highbred, stylish appearance and a charming, crooked smile that reveals very white teeth. Her cheeks have a soft, ripe glow, and she takes great pleasure in dressing fashionably in bright, flattering gowns.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c5 P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 c19 P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005)_

## Personality

Phil is gay, irrepressible, and intensely frivolous on the surface, but possesses a deep, loyal, and womanly nature underneath. She suffers from a comical degree of indecision when choosing between small options, often relying on hatpins or chance to make up her mind. Despite her aristocratic background and wealth, she is entirely free from snobbishness and genuinely affectionate toward her friends. She delights in being popular and surrounded by admirers, yet she is honest, generous, and ungrudging of others' good fortune.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c19 P20](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0020), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

## Goals

- To earn a B.A. degree at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c4 P46](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0046), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)</sub>
- To marry the man she genuinely loves rather than marrying for money or social standing  <sub>[v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Philippa Gordon first met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant in Old St. John's Cemetery during their freshman year at Redmond College. Finding herself instantly drawn to them, she introduced them into her wide social circle and became a close friend. The following year, she joined Anne, Priscilla, and Stella Maynard in renting Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, where she lived happily under the care of Aunt Jamesina. Although pursued by numerous admirers, including her hometown suitors Alec and Alonzo, Phil eventually fell deeply in love with Jonas Blake, a poor divinity student. Overcoming her initial reluctance to marry a poor man, she accepted his proposal during her junior year and stood firm against her mother's objections. After completing her Arts course and taking High Honors in Mathematics at Redmond, Philippa married Jonas in Bolingbroke with Anne as her bridesmaid.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021), [v3 c27 P18](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0018), [v3 c27 P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)_

## Quotes

> Shyness isn’t among the many failings—or virtues—of Philippa Gordon—Phil for short.  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

> I can’t decide even on my own appearance. Just as soon as I’ve decided that I’m pretty I begin to feel miserably that I’m not.  <sub>[v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040)</sub>

> I’m sure it must be a great deal better to be sensible; but still, I don’t believe I’d really want to be a sensible person, because they are so unromantic.  <sub>[v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001)</sub>

> I’m not frivolous at heart. But there’s a sort of frivolous skin over my soul and I can’t take it off.  <sub>[v3 c27 P20](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0020)</sub>

> I’ll be as gaily poor as I’ve been rich.  <sub>[v3 c27 P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031)</sub>
